scenarios.name: Stage the same command with different display options on two targets

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows All Commands and empty Part Tools and Part Manage targets
the user stages 2D Sketches on Part Tools
the user checks its Large and Text options
the user switches the target to Part Manage
the user stages 2D Sketches on Part Manage
the Part Manage row has Large and Text unchecked
the Part Manage target shows a pending-change marker
the user switches the target back to Part Tools
2D Sketches remains staged on Part Tools
its Large and Text options are checked
the Part Tools target shows a pending-change marker
